Faye (Support): Escalation: PulseMed onboarding demo hit repeated embedding 504s and long tails during live walkthrough. Ticket 772311 opened.
Rory (CS Ops): Acknowledged. Are they Hosted or Dedicated and what's the model? I can draft comms and coordinate a mitigation window.

Kim (CSM): I'll own customer comms + enablement. Propose: immediate ack + 90m ETA, apply temporary routing to embed-xstable for demo hours, offer 500 embed credits, schedule 30m enablement. Nina 1AE1 can you confirm renewal timing?

ticket-bot: INC-772311 created from #772311 1 assignee=eng-runtime priority=P1.
Victor (eng-runtime): Quick triage: signs of batch coalescing with large shared prefixes causing KV cache churn. Short-term mitigation: tenant_single_batch flag + route demo traffic to embed-xstable. I can enable flags for a 2h window now. Need a representative failed payload for deeper repro.
Faye (Support): Redacted payload: "normalize intake form -> map to ICD/SNOMED" failed at 2026-04-12T13:16:09Z. Autoscale is fixed dedicated pool.
Rory (CS Ops): Action items: Victor enable mitigation (owner) and monitor; Kim send ack and schedule enablement; Faye attach full traces to INC-772311; Nina prepare renewal note template.
Kim (CSM): Ack sent to customer and scheduled 30m enablement for 14:00 UTC. Offered 500 embed credits; they replied: "Thanks, please prioritize before Friday." :thumbsup:
Victor (eng-runtime): Mitigation applied: tenant_single_batch=true and demo routes routed to embed-xstable. Early metrics: tail 99p down from 1.7s -> 130ms. Monitoring.
Rory (CS Ops): Great. We'll reconvene after the enablement to finalize a short status note for Nina's renewal call and decide on durable fixes. Thanks team.
